# Allowed gaps in mise.lock files, read by check-lock.sh.
#
# Format, one per line:   tool-key platform  # reason
#   tool-key  exactly as written in the lock, e.g. aqua:PaulJuliusMartinez/jless
#   platform  macos-arm64 | linux-x64 | linux-arm64 | * (all of them)
# Every line needs a reason (why upstream ships no checksummed build). An entry
# whose gap no longer exists is reported as STALE-EXCEPTION and fails CI, so
# delete lines as soon as they stop being needed.
pipx:ansible-core *  # pipx tools are locked by a hash-pinned uv.lock under .mise/locks/ (digest recorded in mise.lock), not per-platform archive checksums
pipx:ansible-lint *  # pipx tools are locked by a hash-pinned uv.lock under .mise/locks/ (digest recorded in mise.lock), not per-platform archive checksums
pipx:pre-commit *  # pipx tools are locked by a hash-pinned uv.lock under .mise/locks/ (digest recorded in mise.lock), not per-platform archive checksums
